messages:
anya: Quick bring-up for boreal-7b variants (baseline fp16-13b). Need a short routing + unit-econ rec for product.

mike: drop numbers?

anya: TL;DR: int6 is strong sweet spot; int4 saves $$ but has factuality/regression risk on long-context. Short numbers: 
- boreal-7b-int6: p50=68ms, p95=155ms, synth-qa delta=-0.5pp vs fp16, throughput~1100 tok/s, est $0.66/1M
- boreal-7b-int4: p50=58ms, p95=210ms, synth-qa delta=-2.7pp, throughput~1400 tok/s, est $0.39/1M
- fallback core-13b-int8: p50=135ms, p95=340ms, synth-qa delta=-0.2pp, throughput~700 tok/s, est $1.09/1M

leah: int4 p95 worse than int6 = KV cold-starts + some long-summary hallucination?

anya: Exactly. Cold-starts on >500 token histories and a 1.5% failure mode on long-summary factuality.

sam: any quick gating idea to keep int4 cheap but safe?

anya: Smallset of mitigations that looked promising in shortloop: 
1) Route int4 only for query_tokens <= 60 AND history_tokens <= 120.
2) Entropy hijack: if token_entropy > 3.1 -> route to 13b.
3) Periodic warm-probes for cheap-bucket (1 probe / 6k active users) to keep KV hot.

sample route sketch: 
```
routes:
  - name: cheap-chat
    model: boreal-7b-int4
    match:
      - query_tokens <= 60
      - history_tokens <= 120
    weight: 0.25
  - name: default
    model: boreal-7b-int6
    weight: 0.65
  - name: safety-fallback
    model: core-13b-int8
    match: entropy > 3.1 or response_tokens > 200
    weight: 0.10
```

anya: blended cost estimate w/ that split = 0.65*0.66 + 0.25*0.39 + 0.10*1.09 = ~$0.63 / 1M tokens. Expected p95 <240ms for ~90% traffic.

mike: product messaging suggestion?

leah: "Estimated QA impact ~0.5-1.2pp vs fp16-13b under proposed routing; targeted fallbacks and entropy-based hijacks protect long-context and low-confidence requests. Monitoring + rollback guardrails enabled."

ops-bot: deploy-canary: route config applied to canary c-202511-22, 1% traffic, start=2025-11-22T10:00:00Z :rocket:

sam: monitor per-route synth-qa delta, p95, hijack-rate, warmed-kv hit-rate. Rollback cheap-chat if synth-qa drift >1.5pp sustained for 30m.

anya: I'll publish a minimal dashboard + a 6h canary runbook and post the 6h snapshot here. :bar_chart:
